query:
UPDATE bear_work_runs
         SET result_refs = COALESCE(result_refs, '{}'::jsonb)
                 || jsonb_build_object('armature_report',
                        jsonb_build_object('status_hint', $3::text, 'summary', $4::text)),
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1 AND bear_id = $2
